Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added 48-hour visited-world markers to the travel destination list. Worlds selected through the Travel button are shown in orange until their marker expires. Added a Clear visited button for manually clearing recent world markers.
